# 1 Kings Chapter 15 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-in-the-eighteenth year-of the-king Jeroboam son-of Nebat, Abijam became-king over Judah.

**2** Three years he-reigned in-Jerusalem. And-the-name-of his-mother was Maacah daughter-of Abishalom.

**3** And-he-walked in-all the-sins-of his-father that he-did before-him, and-his-heart was-not complete with YHWH his-God, like-the-heart-of David his-father.

**4** For for-the-sake-of David, YHWH his-God gave to-him a-lamp in-Jerusalem, to-raise-up ʾet-his-son after-him and-to-establish ʾet-Jerusalem,

**5** because David did the-right in-the-eyes-of YHWH and-did-not turn-aside from-all that he-commanded-him all the-days-of his-life — except in-the-matter-of Uriah the-Hittite.

**6** And-war was between Rehoboam and-Jeroboam all the-days-of his-life.

**7** And-the-rest-of the-acts-of Abijam and-all that he-did — are-they not written in-the-Book-of the-Chronicles-of the-Kings-of Judah? And-war was between Abijam and-Jeroboam.

**8** And-Abijam lay-down with his-fathers, and-they-buried-him in-the-City-of David. And-Asa his-son reigned in-his-place.

**9** And-in-the-twentieth year-of Jeroboam king-of Israel, Asa became-king over Judah.

**10** And-forty-one years he-reigned in-Jerusalem. And-the-name-of his-mother was Maacah daughter-of Abishalom.

**11** And-Asa did the-right in-the-eyes-of YHWH, like-David his-father.

**12** And-he-removed ʾet-the-cult-prostitutes from the-land and-removed ʾet-all the-idols that his-fathers had-made.

**13** And-also ʾet-Maacah his-mother — he-removed-her from-being queen-mother, because she-had-made a-horrifying-image for-Asherah. And-Asa cut-down her-horrifying-image and-burned-it in-the-brook Kidron.

**14** But-the-high-places were-not removed. Nevertheless the-heart-of Asa was complete with YHWH all his-days.

**15** And-he-brought ʾet-the-holy-things-of his-father and-his-own-holy-things into-the-house-of YHWH — silver and-gold and-vessels.

**16** And-war was between Asa and-Baasha king-of Israel all their-days.

**17** And-Baasha king-of Israel went-up against Judah and-built ʾet-Ramah, to-not allow going-out or-coming-in to-Asa king-of Judah.

**18** And-Asa took ʾet-all the-silver and-the-gold that-remained in-the-treasuries-of the-house-of YHWH and-the-treasuries-of the-house-of the-king, and-gave-them in-the-hand-of his-servants. And-the-king Asa sent-them to Ben-hadad son-of Tabrimmon son-of Hezion, king-of Aram, who-dwelt in-Damascus, saying,

**19** "A-covenant is between-me and-between-you, between my-father and-between your-father. Behold, I-have-sent to-you a-gift-of silver and-gold. Go, break your-covenant with Baasha king-of Israel, and-he-will-go-up from-upon-me."

**20** And-Ben-hadad listened to the-king Asa and-sent ʾet-the-commanders-of the-armies that were-his against the-cities-of Israel, and-struck ʾet-Ijon and-ʾet-Dan and-ʾet-Abel-beth-maacah and-all Chinneroth, with all the-land-of Naphtali.

**21** And-it-was when-Baasha heard, and-he-stopped building ʾet-Ramah and-dwelt in-Tirzah.

**22** And-the-king Asa summoned ʾet-all Judah — none was-exempt — and-they-carried-away ʾet-the-stones-of Ramah and-ʾet-its-timber that Baasha had-built. And-the-king Asa built with-them ʾet-Geba-of-Benjamin and-ʾet-Mizpah.

**23** And-the-rest-of all the-acts-of Asa, and-all his-might, and-all that he-did, and-the-cities that he-built — are-they not written in-the-Book-of the-Chronicles-of the-Kings-of Judah? Only, at-the-time-of his-old-age he-was-diseased in-his-feet.

**24** And-Asa lay-down with his-fathers and-was-buried with his-fathers in-the-City-of David his-father. And-Jehoshaphat his-son reigned in-his-place.

**25** And-Nadab son-of Jeroboam became-king over Israel in-the-second year-of Asa king-of Judah. And-he-reigned over Israel two years.

**26** And-he-did the-evil in-the-eyes-of YHWH and-walked in-the-way-of his-father and-in-his-sin that he-caused Israel to-sin.

**27** And-Baasha son-of Ahijah, of-the-house-of Issachar, conspired against-him. And-Baasha struck-him at-Gibbethon, which belonged-to the-Philistines, while-Nadab and-all Israel were-besieging Gibbethon.

**28** And-Baasha killed-him in-the-third year-of Asa king-of Judah, and-reigned in-his-place.

**29** And-it-was when-he-became-king, he-struck ʾet-all the-house-of Jeroboam. He-did-not leave to-Jeroboam any breathing-thing, until he-destroyed-him, according-to-the-word-of YHWH that he-spoke by-the-hand-of his-servant Ahijah the-Shilonite —

**30** because-of the-sins-of Jeroboam that he-sinned and-that he-caused Israel to-sin, and-because-of his-provocation with-which he-provoked YHWH, the-God-of Israel.

**31** And-the-rest-of the-acts-of Nadab and-all that he-did — are-they not written in-the-Book-of the-Chronicles-of the-Kings-of Israel?

**32** And-war was between Asa and-Baasha king-of Israel all their-days.

**33** In-the-third year-of Asa king-of Judah, Baasha son-of Ahijah became-king over all Israel in-Tirzah — twenty-four years.

**34** And-he-did the-evil in-the-eyes-of YHWH, and-walked in-the-way-of Jeroboam and-in-his-sin that he-caused Israel to-sin.

---
## EMET Textual Notes

1. **15:4 — "a-lamp"**: The ner (lamp) motif continues — David's line preserved not for its own merit but for David's sake. The lamp is fragile but God refuses to let it go out.
2. **15:5 — "except in-the-matter-of Uriah"**: The narrator's only qualification of David's righteousness. The Bathsheba-Uriah affair remains the one stain on an otherwise commended life.
3. **15:13 — queen-mother deposed**: Asa removes his own grandmother from her position for idolatry. This act of religious reform cuts across family loyalty — a rare instance of a king prioritizing YHWH over dynasty.
4. **15:29 — "any breathing-thing"**: The fulfillment of Ahijah's prophecy (14:10). Jeroboam's entire house is annihilated. The phrase kol-nishmat echoes the herem language of holy war.

— EMET
